description: This Java class 'DefaultTbDashboardService' implements dashboard management functionalities such as save, delete, assign/unassign dashboards to/from customers, edges, and public customers within the Thingsboard platform. It extends an abstract service and interacts with other services and data models to perform these operations.

classes.name: DefaultTbDashboardService
classes.description: Service class for managing dashboards, including creation, deletion, and assignment to customers, edges, and public customers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a dashboard, importing resources if present, and logs the action.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard and logs the deletion.

methods.name: assignDashboardToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to a specific customer and logs the assignment.

methods.name: assignDashboardToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to the public customer and logs the action.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromPublicCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns a dashboard from the public customer and logs the action.

methods.name: updateDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Updates the set of customers assigned to a dashboard, handling additions and removals.

methods.name: addDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Adds customers to a dashboard's assignment.

methods.name: removeDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Removes customers from a dashboard's assignment.

methods.name: asignDashboardToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to an edge device.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a dashboard from an edge device.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns a dashboard from a customer.
